postReview.title: Pisa 0-2 Inter: el doblete de Lautaro Martínez mantiene la presión sobre el Milan

postReview.title: Pisa 0-2 Inter: Martinez brace maintains pressure on rivals Milan
postReview.description: Inter bounced back from their derby defeat against AC Milan last weekend, with Lautaro Martinez's second-half brace helping them past Pisa.

postReview.title: Pisa 0:2 Inter: Martinez-Doppelpack hält den Druck auf Rivalen AC Mailand hoch

postReview.title: Pisa 0-2 Inter: bis de Lautaro Martínez mantém pressão sobre o rival Milan
